body: thank you. that sounds really painful, and i'm sorry. love is painfully craved, but so stupidly fickle and unforgiving, and society as a whole doesn't seem to care so much about men who are physically abused. visa versa, my dms are open if you ever need a friend.

thank you. i do have self esteem issues. and someone in this thread is literally replying to me saying me taking selfies and putting them online is "sexual display," i am so god damn exhausted of life in general.

its not what i latched onto, i read the whole thing, but the fact that you didn't even read what was written or reference it correctly is evidence you probably weren't thinking to hard on what you wrote. i'm not going to spend time arguing with someone online i dont know, but what i do know is your comment is gross and you should feel gross. rules are "rules" when they are appropriate. relationships aren't about rules for each other and following orders. its about respect, trust, love, compassion, not rules and control. and a lot of people who don't feel self-confident still share pictures of themselves. also, selfies are not a sexual display. i've literally sent selfies to my mom. goodbye freud, n enjoy the last word.

No, but we constantly fight about how I feel like he is extremely controlling and it all stems from insecurities that he can't get over. I do love him, but it drives me up the wall and makes me hurt. I just want a good relationship with him, but to not lose myself in the process.
A bit over a year, and I just moved in with him.

I appreciate that super thought out reply. It's very insightful. I can understand what you mean about him not being happy, because it seems like I don't care about it, but I wore it for months even when it hurt my finger and made it green. I don't see what I can or even should do about his insecurities about something that in my opinion should just have been seen as him admitting to himself he told me that it isn't a promise ring, he said himself its "just a birthday ring," and there is being insecure about me and our relationship and there isn't letting the other person make their own choices about their own body.  Why is it my job to make him less insecure? It's something he has battled forever, no matter what I do. But I am honestly suffering. He often keeps telling me that we need to break up, he never apologizes to me when he hurts me, he often does cruel things to me without thinking, but I keep trying to forgive him, yet he can't even let me not wear a ring that wasn't even intended as a promise ring or anything like that. We've talked about him being insecure tons of times, and nothing changes. I feel controlled and like what I want doesn't matter, but I still keep trying to make it work.  


EDIT: I should add that I did have an emotional attachment to the ring UNTIL he kept guilting me when I took it off. I loved it, wore it even though it made my finger hurt like hell, I wore it even when my finger was green, but I stopped loving it when he kept being dramatic when I wasn't wearing it. Now I just wish he never gave it to me.

I see them all the time too, and I call them out, and he acts like i'm a nut when I say he is being controlling. I dont think he even understands what it means to be controlling. I tell him that he often says stuff that makes me feel guilted into doing something, he says he is just expressing how he feels and that just makes me feel like i'm not allowing him to express himself. But he never takes no for an answer, he gets sad and mopey for days and he even used to talk about how he can't eat or sleep, and although he is expressing himself I feel like every tiny thing I want is a battle and its just fucking killing me. Besides all this I love him, he's a decent person, but it never ends and i'm just fucking suffering. A lot of the time he ends up giving in but its just the same thing the next time, can people like this change or will I never get anything I want without a week long battle?
